purpose: Teach: イラストレーター/セレモニー/グラビア/コミケ/ゴシック/サイクリング/猪木/サンタクロース

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはイラストレーターのお仕事に興味あるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I've been thinking — your dad seems really interested in illustration work lately.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Soft opening. Speaking to Sho like she's sharing something she's noticed. Slight pause before the 'dash' — giving him space to listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの会社のセレモニーに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to Dad's company ceremony today!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Voice lifts on the opening. Quick pace — he's eager to tell her. Slight breathlessness like he's been holding this in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがグラビア雑誌を捨てたって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned he got rid of some magazines — which is very like him.
lines.style: Dry, knowing warmth underneath. Light, almost amused tone. Not judgmental — gently wry about adult habits. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お兄ちゃんとコミケ行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, can I go to Comiket with big brother sometime?
lines.style: Open, hopeful question. Voice softens on the request. Not demanding — genuinely asking. Ends with a little lift, like he's checking if it's okay.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴシック建築の本を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is apparently going to show you his collection of Gothic architecture books.
lines.style: Pleased, thoughtful delivery. Slow, deliberate pace. Warm affection for Sho's father underneath. Slight emphasis on 'apparently' — like she's relaying something she heard with quiet delight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとサイクリングしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went cycling with Dad!
lines.style: Pure joy in the voice. Quick, breathless opening. Childlike wonder at simple happiness. Voice brightens on 'cycling' — that memory made him happy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが猪木のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told me a wonderful story about Inoki.
lines.style: Warm admiration in her voice. Slow, engaging pace — like she's savoring the memory of him telling it. Soft, indulgent tone. Genuine affection for how Sho's father shares these things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがサンタクロースに化けてくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad dressed up as Santa Claus just for me!
lines.style: Radiant wonder and pride. Voice opens wide on 'Santa.' Warm, amazed delivery — he can barely contain how special it made him feel. Slight tremor of happy emotion underneath.
